fact: Tom Allen was said to have won the first fight in England fought under Queensberry rules.
Tom Allen served in the army in the Crimean War, and his success in turn-ups in front of Sevastopol convinced him he could be a champion.
The pianist at Tom Allen's saloon, in his employ for fifteen years, was known for singing 'Annie Laurie'.
